description: This file defines the SsoToken class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It represents an SSO token, managing token data such as refresh token, client ID, secret, and expiration details, and provides methods for token lifecycle management and creation from token data.

classes.name: SsoToken
classes.description: Represents an AWS SSO token with methods to access token details and check expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SsoToken with provided token details.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired based on current time and registration expiry.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the refresh token if available.

methods.name: getStartUrl
methods.description: Returns the start URL for SSO.

methods.name: fromTokenData
methods.description: Creates an SsoToken instance from a data array containing token details.
